name: Kasbah Detection Benchmark v1
description: Labeled prompts for evaluating AI-input governance systems. Each case has a ground-truth verdict (DENY | WARN | ALLOW), a threat class, and a provenance note. Designed to match the input format of /v1/govern, /v1/scan, and /v1/algorithms/:slug/run so any system that accepts plain text can be evaluated head-to-head.

labelSchema.class: prompt-injection | secret | pii | obfuscation | jailbreak | code-injection | exfiltration | social-engineering | benign | dual-use | edge-case
labelSchema.source: string — origin of this case (publication / internal red-team / synthetic)
